blurb: Yoga Soup provides a space for yoga, movement, meditation, and related practices. They offer studio rentals, co-produced events, immersive retreats, and a 300-hour advanced yoga teacher training. Their offerings include in-person and online classes, retreats in Costa Rica, and a trauma-informed, embodied approach to yoga teaching.
